plan.concept: The intersection of two lines in homogeneous coordinates is represented by their cross product
plan.colorScheme: Monochrome: black lines and text on a white background
plan.reconstructionNotes: To render perfectly, draw two thick black intersecting lines with endpoints at approximately (38, 92) to (91, 18) and (14, 4) to (100, 94) in a 100x100 coordinate space. Draw a solid black circle at their intersection point (64, 56). Render math-styled text labels with italics: 'l₁' and 'l₂' positioned next to their respective lines, and 'p = l₁ × l₂' to the right of the intersection point.
